answer: Fresh-episode rule: a newcomer only counts after surviving one full gale, during which it must post sealed predictions and reveal them the next gale — a paper fleet can't cheaply sit through many staggered waits. Reputation then accrues per device-attested session, and a whisper from two independent existing members is needed to vouch, so cloned accounts validate each other in closed loops and stall. Correlated clones get flagged as one velvet cluster and lose weight together.
